"The Truth About Wilson". Who'd ever have thought that in our sphere we would seriously concern ourselves with such ficticious nonsense...with so much data recorded.. performances observed....sagacious timekeepers..impossible.. and yet.. he HAS been observed.

Support from other Belgravians was fantastic, Captain Ray Hall, Charlie MacLennan, Carl Lawton, Brian Ward, Johnny Morris, Steve Brown, The Wilson brothers as well as many others all played a part on this hot day.

Handbook, MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNING by Tony Ward; STRENGTH TRAINING by Ron Pickering; CIRCUIT TRAINING by Adamson and Morgan; THE COMPLETE MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNER by Messrs. Watts, Wilson and Horwill. I consider any middle-distance coach who hasn't got these on his shelf is missing out a lot.

I must say they do make a difference from running round the streets of London in ex-WD army boots, Zatopek style! Editor's Note: Could this new member be Belgrave's answer to the legendary Wilson and Alf Tupper (Britain's first four minute smiler)?

Another heart-stopping roar rent the air serving to wake our William from his shocked state, and with a turn of speed that could not have been matched by any but the legendary Wilson, he ran until his lungs were near to bursting.
